```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r instalar, eval=FALSE}
BiocManager::install("TENxBrainData")
```

```{r libraries}
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(TENxBrainData)
library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r preparar_datos}
# Descargar datos y seleccionar 3000 células
sce <- TENxBrainData20k()
set.seed(42)
sce <- sce[, sample(ncol(sce), 3000)]

# Asignar símbolos génicos; usar Ensembl cuando falte el símbolo
simbolos <- as.character(rowData(sce)$Symbol)
ensembl <- as.character(rowData(sce)$Ensembl)
simbolos[is.na(simbolos) | simbolos == ""] <-
  ensembl[is.na(simbolos) | simbolos == ""]
rownames(sce) <- make.unique(simbolos)

# Asignar identificadores celulares únicos
colnames(sce) <- make.unique(
  paste(colData(sce)$Library, colData(sce)$Barcode, sep = "_")
)

# Extraer matriz de UMI y crear objeto Seurat
counts <- as(assay(sce, "counts"), "dgCMatrix")
obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, project = "Brain_E18")

obj
```
```{r}
rownames(obj)[1:10]
genes_mt <- grep("^mt-", rownames(obj), value = TRUE)
obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(obj, features = genes_mt)

summary(obj[[]])
```
```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
VlnPlot(obj, features = c("nCount_RNA", "nFeature_RNA", "percent.mt"), layer = "counts", ncol = 3, pt.size = 0.1)
```
```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
FeatureScatter(obj, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA") |
  FeatureScatter(obj, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt")
```

```{r}
antes <- c(Celulas = ncol(obj), Genes = nrow(obj), 
           Genes_detectados = sum(Matrix::rowSums(counts) > 0))
antes

obj <- subset(obj, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 5000 & percent.mt < 10)
despues <- c(Celulas = ncol(obj), Genes = nrow(obj), 
           Genes_detectados = sum(Matrix::rowSums(counts) > 0))
despues
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
VlnPlot(obj, features = c("nCount_RNA", "nFeature_RNA", "percent.mt"), layer = "counts", ncol = 3, pt.size = 0.1)
```
```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
FeatureScatter(obj, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA") |
  FeatureScatter(obj, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt")
```

```{r}
original <- GetAssayData(obj, layer = "counts")[, colnames(obj)]
obj <- NormalizeData(obj, normalization.method = "LogNormalize")
normalizados <- GetAssayData(obj, layer = "data")[, colnames(obj)]

hist(original@x, breaks = 50) | 
hist(normalizados@x, breaks = 50)
```
```{r}
obj <- FindVariableFeatures(obj, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
top10 <- head(VariableFeatures(obj),10)
top10

LabelPoints(plot = VariableFeaturePlot(obj), points = top10, repel = TRUE)
obj <- ScaleData(obj, features = VariableFeatures(obj))

obj <- RunPCA(obj, features = VariableFeatures(obj), npcs = 2000, approx = FALSE)
```

```{r}
ElbowPlot(obj, ndims = 50)
VizDimLoadings(obj, dims = 1:2)
```
```{r}
obj <- FindNeighbors(obj, dims = 1:20)
obj <- FindClusters(obj, resolution = 0.5, random.seed = 42)
```

```{r}
table(Idents(obj))
prop.table(table(Idents(obj)))
barplot(table(Idents(obj)))
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=5}
obj <- RunUMAP(obj, dims = 1:20, n.neighbors = 30, min.dist = 0.3, set.seed = 42)
DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE)

obj <- RunUMAP(obj, dims = 1:20, n.neighbors = 30, min.dist = 0.1, set.seed = 42, reduction.name = "umap1")
DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE) | DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap1", label = TRUE)

obj <- RunUMAP(obj, dims = 1:20, n.neighbors = 10, min.dist = 0.3, set.seed = 42, reduction.name = "umap2")
DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE) | DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap2", label = TRUE)
```
```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}
obj <- RunTSNE(obj, dims = 1:20, set.seed = 42, perplexity = 30)
DimPlot(obj, reduction = "tsne", label = TRUE)

obj <- RunTSNE(obj, dims = 1:20, set.seed = 42, perplexity = 80, reduction.name = "tsne1")
DimPlot(obj, reduction = "tsne", label = TRUE) | DimPlot(obj, reduction = "tsne1", label = TRUE)

obj <- RunTSNE(obj, dims = 1:20, set.seed = 42, perplexity = 10, reduction.name = "tsne2")
DimPlot(obj, reduction = "tsne", label = TRUE) | DimPlot(obj, reduction = "tsne2", label = TRUE)

DimPlot(obj, reduction = "tsne", label = TRUE) | DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE)
```

```{r}
FeaturePlot(obj, features = "nCount_RNA", reduction = "umap")
```

```{r, fig.width=20, fig.height=5}
VlnPlot(obj, features = c("nCount_RNA", "nFeature_RNA", "percent.mt"), layer = "counts", ncol = 3, pt.size = 0.1)
```
```{r}
metadata <- as.data.frame(colData(sce))
obj$raton <- factor(metadata[colnames(obj), "Mouse"], levels = c("A", "B"))
table(obj$raton)

VlnPlot(obj, features = c("nCount_RNA", "nFeature_RNA", "percent.mt"), layer = "counts", ncol = 3, pt.size = 0.1, group.by = "raton")
DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap", group.by = "raton")
```
